Question:
How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT f1.session
FROM form_log f1
JOIN form_log f2 ON f1.session = f2.session
WHERE f1.path = '/regist/input'
  AND f2.path = '/regist/confirm'
  AND f2.stamp > f1.stamp

[B]
SQL:
WITH input_visits AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_input_stamp
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
confirm_visits AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_confirm_stamp
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.session) as unique_sessions
FROM input_visits i
JOIN confirm_visits c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.first_input_stamp < c.first_confirm_stamp

    SELECT session, MIN(CASE WHEN path = '/regist/input' THEN stamp END) as input_time

),

    SELECT session, MIN(CASE WHEN path = '/regist/confirm' THEN stamp END) as confirm_time

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.session) as unique_sessions
FROM input_visits i
